findings.message: FIND-001: Original inventory and predecessor evidence remain intact locally. Scoped owner decisions and video review are now recorded; durable remote custody and final-scope reviewer access/acceptance remain unverified. Remaining exit: Exact immutable revision and reviewer-readable originals are confirmed; local readability/admin access alone is insufficient.

FIND-002: Original inventory preserved. Owner supplied an empty repository Packages view and reviewed both identified videos. Owner reports removing the two caches; a successful paginated GET now returns zero entries. Cache contents were never inspected. Complete package coverage, final source/ref reconciliation and remaining category acceptance are still pending. Remaining exit: All 16 current exposure categories and formerly inaccessible bodies have attributable complete review or demonstrated absence.

FIND-003: All four owner-classification questions from the seven deduplicated values have attributable decisions; three technical fixture/false-positive groups remain documented. Final exposure reconciliation and complete requirement assessment remain pending; no disclosure waiver or broad rights clearance inferred. Remaining exit: Every actual finding has attributable non-sensitive disposition or verified authorized treatment; destructive/history/destination changes reopen planning.

FIND-004: D1/D2 accepted for HPB-RIGHTS-02 first-party snapshot; 16 candidate texts and nine preimages remain exact. Later source delta still needs final reconciliation. Remaining exit: Current rights, candidate applicability and review capacity support the exact proposed scope; no approval transfers to unseen content.

FIND-005: R3 general fallback applied locally; 12 specific entries preserved. Main still uses Elvis-only fallback. Current read-only observations retain private capability limits. Actual session participants, writer freeze and final private clearance remain unconfirmed. Remaining exit: Exact local ownership/guidance and actual private inputs verified; public enforcement remains separately mandatory and unverified.

FIND-006: Both owners selected for shared triage; existing admin roles observed individually. Actual availability/handler/handover readiness and public PVR access/receipt remain unverified. Remaining exit: Feasible per-person private prerequisites evidenced and public activation/access/receipt/handover/exclusion protocol assigned; no role-to-receipt inference.

scope: Declared contract checks only; archive inventory is historical unless selected for live delivery. No proof of semantic adequacy, execution authenticity, human identity, remote CI, merge or deployment.
